root_cause: MergeSemantics was implemented as do-not-traverse with no aggregate node, so a merging group produced zero nodes.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs: merging elements always emit a node (GenericContainer when no role); label = own label plus descendant labels joined by newline (merged_semantic_label / push_merged_labels); buttons stop descent because their label gathers their subtree.
limitations: Merged node carries only its own role, actions and state; descendant actions, flags and values are not merged.

root_cause: SemanticState::enabled defaulted to false, so an unspecified enabled state projected as disabled.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs: manual Default with enabled = true; only an explicit false disables.
harness: semantics__enabled_default: still DIVERGES in the raw twin value only (bool 1 vs Flutter tristate none 2); the projection now treats the state as enabled
api_change: Default for SemanticState changed: enabled is true by default. Code relying on default-disabled must call enabled(false).
limitations: enabled is still a bool, so the tristate none is not represented.
note: accessibility test static_content_controls... now sets enabled = false explicitly.

root_cause: Scroll and sliver viewports always advertised ScrollForward and ScrollBackward, and scroll offset changes are compositor-only, so the node was never re-collected.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs: scroll_edge_actions (forward only below max, backward only above 0); update_semantics marks scroll nodes Node when the scroll offset stamp changes.
limitations: Scroll nodes are re-collected on every scroll frame while semantics is enabled.

root_cause: Semantics without a role produced no explicit descriptor, and node creation required a role.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs: explicit() returns a GenericContainer descriptor whenever metadata is present; tree/semantics.rs overlays role-less wrappers onto built-in roles (overlay_semantic_state).
limitations: Labelled wrappers always create a node; Flutter's default merge of a non-container label into its ancestor is not reproduced (see semantics-012).

root_cause: on_tap, on_increase, on_decrease and the scroll callbacks set a default role as a side effect.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs: these builders attach the action only and no longer set a role.
api_change: Apps relying on on_tap implying Button must call button(true).
limitations: The increase-to-slider role was not scenario-checked.

root_cause: hint, tooltip and description all wrote one description field, and state.tooltip was never set.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs: tooltip() writes state.tooltip; hint() keeps writing description.
api_change: Semantics::tooltip no longer sets the description.
limitations: Hint and description still share the description field; no separate hint field was added.

root_cause: GestureDetector callbacks were not mirrored into the semantic action set.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs: a Gesture element with on_tap or on_long_press emits a GenericContainer node with Activate/LongPress; gesture_semantic_callback and semantic_action_is_executable read the detector's callbacks. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/retained.rs semantic_action_callback falls back to the gesture callback (shared-file edit).
limitations: Possible duplicate nodes when a GestureDetector sits under a role-bearing Semantics wrapper; not checked in the wider suite. Drag and scroll gestures not exposed.

root_cause: SemanticActionKind had no LongPress and no callback path existed.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs: LongPress kind and SemanticAction variant. crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs: Semantics::on_long_press. crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/specs.rs and tree/widget/constructors.rs: long_press callback slot. tree/semantics.rs: GestureDetector long press action. crates/incular-runtime/src/frame.rs: LongPress dispatch arm (shared file). crates/incular-accessibility/src/lib.rs: map_action returns None for LongPress.
harness: none: source-only finding, no paired scenario
api_change: Adds SemanticActionKind::LongPress and SemanticAction::LongPress; exhaustive downstream matches need an arm.
limitations: AccessKit has no long-press action, so the desktop tree does not advertise it; the mobile projection does.

root_cause: The node model had no increased or decreased value fields.
change: crates/incular-semantics/src/lib.rs: SemanticState increased_value and decreased_value; crates/incular-widgets/src/semantics.rs: increased_value() and decreased_value() builders.
harness: semantics__increase_decrease: match (twin compares action flags only)
api_change: Adds two public fields to SemanticState (struct literals must use ..Default).
limitations: AccessKit has no property for these values, so they are not projected natively; the mobile projection carries them in state.

root_cause: No sort key exists; sibling order follows the widget tree.
limitations: A sort needs the parent's child list re-sorted when a child's key changes, which requires a parent re-mark in reconciliation (tree/reconciliation.rs, not owned by this worker).

root_cause: No ShowOnScreen action exists and scroll views have no reveal-to-bounds routing.
limitations: Needs a scroll reveal API in incular-scroll plus runtime routing; too large for this pass, and no scenario exists.

root_cause: No container or explicit_child_nodes concept; Flutter's default merge of a non-container label into its ancestor has no Incular counterpart.
limitations: Incular already creates a node per labelled wrapper and never merges children implicitly, so the flags would be no-ops until the implicit-merge rule is decided.

root_cause: CustomPaint has no per-region semantic output.
api_change: would add a semantic region builder to the custom paint descriptor
limitations: Needs a public painter API (regions, bounds, labels) and a custom-paint semantics scene; neither exists. The Semantics wrapper workaround remains.

root_cause: TextSpan carried no semantics label and RichText had no combine step.
change: crates/incular-text/src/spans.rs: TextSpan.semantics_label field, semantics_label() builder, semantics_text() combiner (additive). crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/descriptors.rs: RichText conversion applies accessibility_label when any span sets a label (shared-file edit).
api_change: TextSpan gains a public field; struct literals must use TextSpan::new.
limitations: Combined label joins span labels without separators, as Flutter does; not compared against Flutter output.

root_cause: SetText was advertised on an unfocused editable text field.
change: crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/semantics.rs: the TextField arm adds SetText only when enabled, not read-only and focused.
harness: semantics__set_text: match; twin changed to find the field by role and dispatch only when SetText is advertised (harness/incular/tests/frames/semantics.rs)
limitations: The focused state was not twinned; no focus request exists for both sides.
